intro: The USMNT has not played a World Cup match on home soil since 1994. That changes on June 12, 2026. The team opens Group D against Paraguay at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, kickoff at 6 PM PT. Weston McKennie is part of the squad, and he is also featured in Destination World Cup 2026, which is already streaming on Tubi. Watch the road to the match now, then come back to stream the match itself live, free, with a Tubi account.

whyWatch.body:
Thirty-two years is a long time to wait to host a World Cup match again. This is not just a group stage opener.

Paraguay came through one of the toughest qualification paths in soccer and has no interest in making Los Angeles a comfortable night for the US. This match will tell you a lot about where this team actually stands, especially with Australia and Türkiye still waiting in Group D.

items.heading: Fox Pregame
items.paragraph: The broadcast starts before kickoff with Fox Pregame, where you get team news, lineup context, and a real feel for the atmosphere building inside Los Angeles Stadium. For a home World Cup opener, the buildup is not filler. It is part of what makes the night feel as big as it is.

items.heading: USA vs. Paraguay, 6:00 PM PT, June 12
items.paragraph: This is Match 4 of the tournament and the USMNT's first game of the group stage. Paraguay qualified through CONMEBOL and brings a serious challenge into Inglewood. Ricardo Pepi leads the attack, Weston McKennie anchors the midfield, and the US will need to handle both the pressure of a home crowd and a team that earned its spot the hard way.

items.heading: Post-game coverage
items.paragraph: After the final whistle, Fox's post-match show breaks down the result live on Tubi. Whether the US starts strong or leaves fans with more questions than answers, the post-game coverage helps you make sense of what just happened before the rest of Group D starts moving.

items.heading: VOD replay
items.paragraph: Miss the live match? The full 90-minute replay goes up on Tubi within 1 to 2 hours after the final whistle. No sign-in required. It includes match footage only, without pregame or post-game coverage.
